app_fee.value: LMU charges no application or tuition fees for doctoral studies.
app_fee.quote: There are no application or tuition fees.

fee_waiver.value: No application fee is charged, so no waiver is needed.
fee_waiver.quote: There are no application or tuition fees.

gre_general.value: LMU has no central office that accepts applications or requires the GRE; individual doctoral regulations specify requirements.
gre_general.quote: There is no central office at LMU that accepts applications for individual doctoral studies.

toefl_min.value: LMU's GraduateCenter states that required language proficiency certificates are not set centrally and are clarified case-by-case (or per structured doctoral program).
toefl_min.quote: The question of which language proficiency certificates must be provided for a doctorate at LMU cannot be answered in general terms, but can only be clarified on a case-by-case basis, usually in consultation with the future supervisor.

ielts_min.value: LMU's GraduateCenter states that required language proficiency certificates are not set centrally and are clarified case-by-case (or per structured doctoral program).
ielts_min.quote: The question of which language proficiency certificates must be provided for a doctorate at LMU cannot be answered in general terms, but can only be clarified on a case-by-case basis, usually in consultation with the future supervisor.

english_waiver.value: Central LMU pages set no university-wide English-medium waiver rule for doctoral applicants (language proof is clarified case-by-case); India is named centrally for the APS certificate requirement.
english_waiver.quote: The question of which language proficiency certificates must be provided for a doctorate at LMU cannot be answered in general terms, but can only be clarified on a case-by-case basis, usually in consultation with the future supervisor.
